name: Airfoil Design Simulation
description: The task focuses on predicting velocity and pressure fields around airfoils in a subsonic regime using ML-based surrogate models to maximize the lift-over-drag ratio while reducing computational costs. The evaluation includes accuracy, computational efficiency, Out-of-Distribution generalization, and physics compliance.

cr:input.name: AirfRANS dataset
cr:input.description: The dataset consists of 2D simulations of airfoil designs represented as point clouds defined via the nodes of the simulation mesh. Input variables include positions, inlet velocity, distance to the airfoil, and normals.
